faq.a: FastAPI is async-native. Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 avoids blocking the event loop on DB calls.
No — the template provides a clean base. Add `fastapi-users` or `authlib` after generation.
Alembic is not included by default. Run `pip install alembic && alembic init migrations` after generation.

faq.q: Can I use this with SQLModel instead?
faq.a: Yes. SQLModel builds on SQLAlchemy + Pydantic. Replace the models/schemas after generation.
